title: DEPS — Structured Product Communication Contract Shadow

sprint.name: Structured Product Communication Contract Shadow
sprint.scope: Pure inactive communication planning over an already-disclosed Organizational Understanding Projection.

evidence.claimBoundary: Sixty deterministic contract, provenance, source-fidelity, uncertainty, alternatives, isolation, replay, non-mutation, active-route, and negative-control checks.
Ownership, contracts, policy, availability, benchmark comparison, Local Understanding Utility disposition, limitations, and rollback.
Existing active product behavior, persisted Runtime replay, and non-mutation regression.
Resolved-decision disclosure, revocation, isolation, and truth noninterference.

scorecard.rationale: The plan orders and references existing disclosed cognition without creating, ranking, or revising Organizational Understanding.
The route is inactive and synthetic structural validation is not a real-user outcome.
No participation, contribution, cross-scope synthesis, or collective learning behavior changed.
Every selected item has explicit provenance and protected, mismatched, mixed-closure, and unsupported inputs fail closed.
A reusable pure contract replaces hidden array-order priority in the candidate path and retains a local rollback boundary.

architecture.observation: Named upstream objectives remain distinct from deterministic lead-for-experience policy.
Readable text is exact field pass-through with owner and source reference; missing text abstains.
The Phase 8A Runtime adapter remains active and the communication compiler is absent from the route.

benchmarks.summary: The inactive plan is deterministic, provenance-complete, source-faithful, disclosure-safe, uncertainty-preserving, and Runtime-independent.
The disclosed projection boundary remains passing.
The inactive product compatibility boundary remains passing.
The active Runtime-backed experience remains unchanged.

researchObservations.observation: Action Utility and Trust Calibration have benchmark support; Understanding Gain, Cognitive Load Reduction, and Continuity remain positive hypotheses; User Intelligence is not measured.

introduced: One pure structured communication contract and organization policy.
One focused sixty-check shadow and benchmark-only negative control.
One measurement-source entry and versioned DEPS report.
complexity.justification: The bounded additions make priority, source fidelity, uncertainty, alternatives, and abstention explicit while keeping Runtime and the active route unchanged.

governanceObservations.observation: Organization, consumer, disclosure, revision, closure, priority producer, objective, and selection provenance remain explicit.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: Communication planning is reusable, pure, versioned, deterministic, non-persistent, and locally reversible.

regressions.observation: No route imports the compiler and existing organization behavior remains the rollback path.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: No user-visible treatment, comprehension study, or decision outcome changed.
The plan contains no generated narrative.
No production disclosure-decision producer or durable revocation owner exists.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: A thin inactive Your Organization adapter is required before product compatibility can be evaluated against the plan.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Phase 8 shadows remain inactive; broader Phase 5 Governance and Phase 6 remain paused.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: Real-user comprehension, active browser behavior, narrative fidelity, decision validity, and revocation-in-application remain unmeasured.

rollback.description: Remove the pure compiler, focused validator, command, measurement source, report, and documentation synchronization; Runtime, projection, compatibility, and the active route remain unchanged.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept the source-pass-through shadow and proceed only to a thin inactive Your Organization communication adapter.
